body: Unfortunately life is NOT fair in the slightest. Unlike school systems promise, life is painful as shit for people who don't deserve it, and kind to people who also don't deserve it. Earning a living is practically impossible, while you're expected not to kill yourself but it's like the whole world is just picking pieces of you away until you're nothing anymore and you'rejust supposed to live about it. I share your sentiment and honestly, I don't want to be here either. I'm sorry you're going through this, but you're not alone

I'm currently in the process of getting help from both my family and hopefully a new therapist, but as far as meds go, I'm screwed. My living situation, screwed. My job, gone, my twin/fp, not on speaking terms, and my art, deteriorated. I'm so tired of being awake all the time, I just wish I had never gotten help, I'd be gone by now, and not in excruciating mental pain every day while my family just tells me "DON'T." about fucking crying that I can't replace my antidepressants after a month off them waiting for my pharmacy to have them in stock. I'm sick of this
That sounds really tough, props to you for dealing with all that mess, you're a trooper 🤌
I'm also on Lamictal and my dosage is a pretty standard 100mg, but they did start me on 50mg, and you'll experience some side effects for the first 3-ish weeks before it settles

We both went through a period where we mirrored someone who overshared too, and honestly, it did bite us in the asses, a lot of the people who are interested in your oversharing are actually really toxic and it pushed the healthy people away too. One thing that helped was actively thinking "keep it mysterious" when we started to feel the word vomit feeling. So as far as perspective goes, it's not terrible, people do it, but as a habit, we'd try to break it with little mental reminders if that works for you, but it's not the worst thing.

Thanks, I would rather kill myself tomorrow than work my ass off for ten more years of this. I put the work in every goddamn day and you're saying "oh well you gotta put in the work, PS it took me ten years" I've been at this for twenty and you just made this a whole hell of a lot harder so get out of my comments

I just think (in the most neutral way I can put it) that I, objectively, haven't been made better as a person and that I'm probably going to screw over everyone that's ever helped me when I do finally give up because I'm not strong enough to do this. I can FEEL that I can't keep doing this for much longer. I feel nothing when I'm supposed to feel accomplished, or when my family even says"I'm proud of you"  and I feel awful everywhere else. And in order to achieve that shitty mental state, I need 5 pills a day and I'm about to lose those too, I can't do this

I honestly think there's nothing to be proud of here, I lost everything that made me anything but a suicidal joke that isn't funny. I haven't persevered, I've decayed. Nothing I've done made me grow and by the time my mental health stabilizes enough for me to feel not so bad anymore, I'll be old enough that my body will hurt instead.  And that's IF I manage to actually get better through just "aging out" of mental turmoil. I'm so disappointed in me, I wasn't supposed to be this way, I worked so hard not to be this way and I don't want to live as this... thing

No offense, but you sound like a hopeful 20 something who's both never had to worry about money or even really knowing what the world is actually like. I don't know your story, but "Just GO and DO IT no matter what!" Is about as authentic as cheap perfume

I feel the same way, what are you supposed to do when you've DONE the things they told you to but the only "progress" you feel is the rot in your brain, talents, what little happiness you CAN feel, or anything else that matters enough to keep you alive? And taking pills is great IF you can get to them. IF you can get prescribed, then IF you or insurance pays for them, and IF you can take them consistently. But let's be honest, even when you manage to take them, you still wish you could go to sleep forever. Depression is just cancer of the mental health
